target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Current Kew accepts the species, but old Central Texas 'G. squarrosa var. nuda' records belong to current G. nuda and are not counted toward G. squarrosa sensu stricto.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Fewer than three exact target-zone counties locked.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not recycle historical synonym/variety records into the wrong current species concept.

morphology.look_here_first: Radiate gumweed with yellow rays and strongly recurved/squarrose resinous phyllaries; requires clean current-concept county evidence.
